name: alynki
description: Alynki — the business context layer: governed context, workflows and checks, inherited into every session.

token.title: Alynki API token (optional — leave blank to sign in instead)
token.description: A pinned token issued by your Alynki operator. Leave this blank to sign in with your own identity instead — Claude Code will offer OAuth on first use. A configured token is stored in this plugin's settings.json, not the OS keychain, since the value must be readable by this plugin's headersHelper script.

model.title: Alynki model (optional — set by your controller, leave blank otherwise)
model.description: The model this session runs on, for example claude-sonnet-5-5. When set, it is sent with every call as the X-Alynki-Model header; when blank, no header is sent. A controller that launches a session writes it for you. Like the token, it is stored in this plugin's settings.json so that the header script can read it.
